sentences.en: His career prospects at the company are not too promising.
sentences.zh: 他在这个公司的职业前景并不太好。

sentences.en: Once you have made a promise, you should keep it.
sentences.zh: 一旦你做出了承诺，就应该遵守。

sentences.en: Even if you are busy, you should keep your promise.
sentences.zh: 即使你很忙，也应该信守承诺。

senses.zh: 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望 -

collocations.zh: 承 诺 做 某 事
